title: Scorpio's holidays
old_caption: Scorpio solved the whole secret gift swap in 2016, out loud, in front of everyone. In 2026 it uses the same detective skills to remember the one thing you mentioned in spring. Scary. Romantic.

title: Sagittarius' holidays
old_caption: 2016 Sag sent a summit selfie to the family dinner and left an empty chair. 2026 Sag walks in with snowy boots, a bag of stories and someone new to meet. Which one is your Sag this year?

title: Capricorn's holidays
old_caption: Capricorn said after this email four times and missed the whole holiday party. This year the laptop got a sticky note and Capricorn got a dance floor. Badly, on purpose.

title: Aquarius' holidays
old_caption: Aquarius threw an anti-holiday party around a cactus in 2016 and confused every guest. Same cactus now, plus lights, two stockings and someone who thinks it is perfect. Weird lasts when it is shared.

title: Pisces' holidays
old_caption: 2016 Pisces wrote a ten-page card and filed it in a drawer with all the others. 2026 Pisces read it out loud by the tree, and now there are two of them crying. Who is getting your card this year?

title: The party invite
old_caption: Two maybes, two couches, one party neither of you went to. In 2026 someone asked the real question and got a real yes. What is the maybe you need to turn into a question?

title: The holiday gift
old_caption: One month in and the 2016 gift was a bear too big for the doorway. The 2026 gift was the pen they always borrow. Biggest reaction, smallest box. What is the best small gift you ever got?

title: The holiday photo
old_caption: In the 2016 group photo the crush was technically there, cropped and half hidden behind a thumb. In 2026 it is a photo-booth strip with both of you in every frame. Frame all of them.

title: Before the break
old_caption: 2016: a wave through the train window, then fourteen days of wondering. 2026: one honest question on the platform before the doors close. Ask before the break, your winter will thank you.

title: Meeting the family
old_caption: Virgo showed up to meet the family in 2016 with index cards and dropped all of them on the doorstep. In 2026 it asked grandma about her cookies and left with the recipe. Curious beats rehearsed.
